value.when: on checks to Make an Impression

why: ADOPTED. They encode two restricted item bonuses we encode nowhere: addBonusToValue SKILL_DIPLOMACY +1 type:item text:'Checks to Make an Impression' and SKILL_INTIMIDATION +1 type:item text:'Checks to Coerce' (raw ops, wg-data.sql line 18086). Our record carried price/bulk/itemType and nothing mechanical, and no situationalBonuses.ts row names it. Ruling B: a flat bonus the rules restrict belongs in `situational` with the restriction in its `when`. Reader verified: explain.ts:359 reads db.items[inv.itemId].situational for any equipped/worn/invested item; probe with the signet invested gave statHasSituational(diplomacy)=true, statHasSituational(intimidation)=true and the Diplomacy breakdown line "+1 item from Commander's Signet — on checks to Make an Impression". The Activate's status bonus to a creature you TOUCH is left unencoded: they do not encode it either, and Ruling F puts an ally's bonus on nobody's sheet.

ADOPTED, replacing ours. We both encode the four held spells and we encode them DIFFERENTLY: ours sat at heldSpells {1:[bless,heal], 2:[cleanse-affliction], 4:[divine-wrath]}; their four giveSpell ops all carry rank:4 (raw data, wg-data.sql line 20465: spellId 4415/4579/4656/4522, type INNATE, rank 4, tradition DIVINE, casts 1). Rule 2 — delete ours, do it their way. Setting the whole field replaces the three old rank keys in one write. Reader verified: with this value a cleric 12 holding the beads gets spellcasting entry {id:'item:inv-0', name:'Holy Prayer Beads (Greater)', type:'items', tradition:'divine', repertoire:{"4":[bless,divine-wrath,heal,cleanse-affliction]}} — all four now castable at the printed 4th rank instead of bless/heal at 1st. The four per-spell `counters` are our shape of their casts:1 and are left exactly as they are.

actionRider.note: The bonus to initiative you grant when you Scout is +2 instead of +1.

why: ADOPTED. Their single op is injectText{type:'action', id:21196} — action 21196 is Scout, the exploration activity (wg-data.sql line 8577). They put the clause on the SCOUT ACTION ROW; we put it only on the initiative row (situationalBonuses.ts:2834). Same reading, different surface, so theirs is added. `modifiesGrant.actionRider` is the only record-FIELD route to an action marker: build.ts:4110 turns it into character.grantMarkers keyed like RECORD_MARKERS, which MainTab.tsx:589 draws beside every action row including the exploration activities (ActionRow is used for shownExplore at line 1122). `from` is the record itself because the gate is ownedIds.has(mod.from) and only feats/classFeatures are in that set — 'scout' is an action id and would never gate. Verified: a ranger 4 with the dedication produced grantMarkers {scout-dedication:[{on:'action', id:'scout', value:'+2', note:...}]} and recordMarkersFor(ch,db,'action','scout') returned it. 'scout' is in no SKILL_ACTIONS list, so the '(+2)' chip cannot land on a skill row it does not belong to. Our initiative star is NOT deleted — it lives in src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts, which this pass may not edit, and Q2 explicitly allows a star and a mark on one record.
